Run every counterfactual from identical model weights, optimizer moments and step counters; fix batches and randomness. A no-step control measures the starting evaluation loss but cannot distinguish current-gradient effects from optimizer history. An explicit-zero-gradient step advances counters, decays moments and can move parameters through retained momentum and weight decay. In PyTorch, `grad=None` skips that parameter’s update, including decay; explicitly allocate zero tensors for the intended active parameters—`zero_grad(set_to_none=False)` does not create missing gradients. [PyTorch documentation](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/main/generated/torch.optim.AdamW.html)

Define affinity using the evaluation-loss difference between the objective-gradient step and its matched zero-gradient step; improvement relative to no-step instead measures the entire optimizer update. This is a conditional current-gradient effect, not a history-free gradient effect: Adam’s moments and adaptive denominator remain involved. Compare matched decay-enabled and decay-disabled controls to assess decay sensitivity. AdamW applies decay separately from moments; ordinary Adam adds the decay term to the gradient, affecting both moments. Disabling decay for this step does not erase historical decay contributions in Adam’s stored moments. [Adam equations](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/main/generated/torch.optim.Adam.html), [AdamW equations](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/main/generated/torch.optim.AdamW.html)

For `L=0.5L_terminal+0.5L_reconstruction`, standalone branch steps use `g_terminal` or `g_reconstruction`; coefficient-scaled ablations use `0.5g_terminal` or `0.5g_reconstruction`. The actual mixture requires one step with their summed gradient. Inference from Adam’s equations: neither averaging standalone parameter updates nor summing zero-control-adjusted branch updates generally reproduces the mixture, because moment adaptation is nonlinear. Measure the mixture directly; use scaled branch-versus-zero and mixture-versus-branch comparisons to describe conditional effects. Apply the actual training clipping pipeline consistently.
